findings.title: [Important] Apology and Notice Regarding Unauthorized Access by a Third Party to Onamae.com Desktop Cloud (As of 4:00, October 21, 2026)
findings.summary_md: GMO Internet's first official advisory confirms unauthorized access by a third party to the Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service, with malicious programs installed in some customer server environments. The company began progressively shutting down customer servers starting at 04:00 local time on October 21, 2026. The notice is dated October 21, 2026 and references a confirmation of intrusion on October 20.

findings.title: [Important] Notice and Apology Regarding Unauthorized Access to "Onamae.com Desktop Cloud" (Second Report)
findings.summary_md: GMO's second advisory, dated October 22, 2026 at 16:54 JST, provides a follow-up to the October 21 announcement. It states that as of October 20, a malicious program had been installed by a third party in the server environments of some Onamae.com Desktop Cloud customers. The company confirms ongoing investigation into unauthorized access and potential customer data compromise.
